name: BACH_0174
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set is Invasive only, input looks typical, and the second model agrees [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0% | One dominant class |
| Conformal set | Invasive only (90%) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.996 / 64th percentile | Typical image |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 Invasive | Two neighbors InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 5, 8, 9) · context · 73% neoplastic nuclei, above 97% of reference images [F7] · Measured
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score; concept model links it to invasive · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; concept model links it to lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Near-typical score; adds little in this case · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20) is Unreliable; lymphocytes (8/20) Weak; these are the two largest terms here.

## Could be wrong if
- Two of five similar cases are InSitu (BACH_0241, BACH_0117); invasion versus in situ may be confused.
- Gland regions 3 and 10 score low invasive risk; a benign or in-situ component may be present.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 10, 11:** are the glands benign, in situ or invasive? Regions 3 and 10 score low risk.
2. **Regions 0, 8:** confirm stromal infiltration and nuclear pleomorphism.
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11:** verify suggested tumor-at-margin call on all four edges [F9].
